name: LIXIL Corporation
summary: LIXIL Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates water technology, housing technology, and living business segments in Japan and internationally. It offers water technology products, including bathroom fixtures, showers, tiles, and faucets; housing technology products, such as window sashes, doors, and exterior building materials; and living business solutions, which provide system kitchens, vanities, and interior products and services. Further, it provides housing solutions, sells and manages real estate, and offers other services. The company markets its products under the INAX, GROHE, American Standard, TOSTEM, RICHELLE, SPAGE, EXSIOR, SUPER WALL, DXV, NODEA, COBRA, and SATO brands. …
